task_instance: Given a simulated long-running debugging agent session (a 401-login-bug investigation, split into two spans of raw transcript, ~63 turns / ~1640 words total), apply the skill's Anchored Iterative Summarization method end-to-end: produce a cycle-1 structured summary (with mandatory sections: Session Intent, Root Cause, Files Modified, Files Read, Decisions Made, Errors Encountered, Current State, Next Steps) from span A; on the next compression trigger, summarize ONLY the new span B content and merge/deduplicate it into the existing summary by file path (never regenerating from scratch) to produce a final structured handoff summary; then run probe-based evaluation (recall, artifact, continuation, decision probes) against the final summary, checked against the raw transcripts as ground truth, to verify the artifact trail and decisions actually survived compression.
evidence: Work directory: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/muratcankoylan__agent-skills-for-context-engineering__context-compression. Files produced: session_transcript_span_A.md (40 turns, 1015 words, simulated raw agent history), session_transcript_span_B.md (23 new turns, 625 words, continuation after first compression trigger), structured_summary_v1.md (cycle-1 anchored summary, 433 words, all 8 mandatory sections populated per the skill's 'Structure Summaries with Mandatory Sections' guidance), structured_summary_v2_final.md (cycle-2 summary produced by summarizing ONLY span B and merging/deduplicating into v1 by file path, per the skill's 'Implement Anchored Iterative Summarization Step by Step' 5-step procedure; each fact is tagged [cycle 1]/[cycle 2] as the skill's step 5 recommends), probe_evaluation.md (4 probe types -- Recall, Artifact, Continuation, Decision -- plus a 5th adversarial artifact-trail probe testing verbatim code identifiers per Gotcha #3/#7). Verification: checked `wc -w` on all four transcript/summary files (raw total 1640 words vs final summary 534 words, ~67% reduction on this small synthetic sample -- the skill's 98%+ ratios are stated as figures for much larger real sessions, and the produced summary correctly demonstrates the anchored/incremental-merge mechanic rather than claiming an inflated ratio). Manually re-derived ground-truth answers from the raw transcripts and compared them against answers obtainable from the compressed summary alone: 4 of 5 probes fully preserved the needed information (error code, exact files touched for the later regression, next steps, and the pool-size decision rationale); the 5th probe correctly surfaced a real, expected compression trade-off (the exact source-code retry-backoff formula is preserved verbatim in the Files Modified section, but the raw millisecond literal for the keepalive interval was compressed to prose), which is exactly the class of failure Gotcha #3 and #7 describe -- confirming the evaluation methodology itself works, not just that a summary was written. No connector/MCP tools, credentials, network access, or work outside the work directory were needed; the entire deliverable (structured summarization, anchored incremental merging, and probe-based verification) was produced and checked using only shell and file operations.
